newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai oil firm to invest 120 bln baht next 5 yrs.
newsitem.headline: Thai oil firm to invest 120 bln baht next 5 yrs.

text.p: Thailand's state-run Petroleum Authority of Thailand (PTT) said on Monday it will spend 120 billion baht ($4.8 billion) between 1997-2001 on investment, mostly on development of natural gas.
The investment is part of PTT's five-year corporate plan, the company said in a statement.

PTT will spend 60 percent of the amount, or 76 billion baht, in natural gas development, 25 percent on downstream and refinery business, and 11 percent on the petrochemical business. The rest of the money will be spent at the company's discretion, a PTT official said.
